title: Jacques Vallée co-opted in the 1980s

tellings.quote: because in the 80s he got taken in by that organization.

plain: Jacques Vallée, a well-known computer scientist and UFO researcher, was taken in during the 1980s by a secretive organization and has worked within its influence since. Steven Greer, a researcher and campaigner on UFOs, says this to Michels without naming a source or saying exactly which organization he means. In Greer's telling, it would explain why Vallée's work fits what that hidden group wants.
